## Changes

- The app now uses the API's new comic source. Your bookmarks and history are moved to it automatically, keeping your reading progress. Large libraries move in batches of 20 comics each time the app opens or syncs. Comics that the new source doesn't have stay in your library but can't be opened.
- The genre filter on Jelajah now loads the current genre list from the server.
- Jelajah sort options match the new source: Z–A is new, and Bookmark and Rating are gone.

Update the app on all your devices: older versions drop the migration marker when they sync.
